ox.web.browser.waitForUserInteraction.description: Pause this Linux Host's Browser automation for an authoring-only human step unsupported by standard service handoffs: `await ox.web.browser.waitForUserInteraction({ purpose, instructions })`. Use the website's login action for authentication and ox.service.showPage for human verification or payment. Stop capture and clear injected scripts first. Never request credentials or challenge tokens. Inspect fresh evidence after the handoff; acknowledgment is not authentication or permission to replay a mutation.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.conversation.start.description: Start an independent conversation in this Linux Host's active Profile: `await ox.conversation.start({ purpose, prompt, title? })`. Uses the configured default model and returns the new conversation UUID without changing the selected conversation or waiting for its answer. Include the complete task in prompt. Read its conversation metadata and transcript before claiming completion; normal Action policies and user-attention requirements still apply.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.media.generateImage.description: Generate one image with this Host's local image model: `await ox.media.generateImage({ purpose, prompt, size?, aspectRatio?, path?, seed? })`. Describe the subject, composition, style, colours and any exact text to show; Chinese and English text render well. size is WIDTHxHEIGHT with each side 512-1536 and a multiple of 64 (default 1024x1024); or give aspectRatio such as 16:9 for a landscape or 9:16 for a portrait image. Saves a PNG in the conversation folder, or at path, and returns its path; show it to the user with Markdown `![short description](path)`. A first call loads the model and can take a minute; it fails explicitly when the Host lacks memory. Images never leave this Host.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

prompt.description: What the image shows, its style and any exact text.

path.description: Optional Profile-relative or conversation-relative .png path to save to.

seed.description: Optional seed to repeat a result.

ox.media.transcribe.description: Transcribe the speech in one audio or video file on this Host: `await ox.media.transcribe({ purpose, path, language? })`. Accepts conversation or shared Profile paths of MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, OGG, Opus, FLAC, WebM, MP4 or MOV files up to 200 MB. Audio stays on this Host. Returns the text and the detected language; quote or summarize it as the task needs.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

language.description: Optional spoken language hint, for example Chinese or English.

ox.media.speak.description: Read text aloud with this Host's local voice model: `await ox.media.speak({ purpose, text, voice?, path? })`. Saves a WAV file in the conversation folder, or at path, and returns its path; link it in the reply with Markdown `[label](path)` so the user can play it. Text up to 2,000 characters; Chinese and English get a natural default voice.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

path.description: Optional Profile-relative or conversation-relative .wav path to save to.

ox.media.inspectVideo.description: Look inside one video on this Host: `await ox.media.inspectVideo({ purpose, path, maxFrames?, transcribe? })`. Saves up to maxFrames evenly spaced frames (default 8, at most 24) as JPEG files in the conversation folder and, unless transcribe is false, transcribes its audio. To see frames, attach the ones you need with ox.fs.attach (up to 4 per execute call). Times are seconds from the start.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

transcribe.description: Whether to transcribe the audio track (default true).

ox.media.renderPages.description: Render pages of a PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file as PNG images on this Host: `await ox.media.renderPages({ purpose, path, first?, last? })`. Use it for scanned PDFs without a text layer, slides, charts, forms and layouts, then attach the pages you need with ox.fs.attach (up to 4 per execute call). Renders at most 20 pages per call into the conversation folder; pages are numbered from 1.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

path.description: PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file path.
